title: Soul Feast #48: Are Current World Events the Cause of My Emotional Pain?
excerpt: https://youtu.be/77PY76vdwNg Are you practicing judgment or discernment?

https://youtu.be/77PY76vdwNg

Are you practicing judgment or discernment? Learn more as Gary explains the difference in this illuminating video.

In this thought-provoking Soul Feast of The Gary Zukav Deepcast, Gary explores the root of emotional pain in the midst of current world events. While it’s easy to believe that the turmoil “out there” is the source of our suffering, Gary reveals that our pain actually comes from within – from a frightened part of our personality that reacts from fear. These parts create a cycle of pain and destructive choices, keeping us locked in the old consciousness.

Gary offers a new way to break free: by becoming aware of our emotions and using them as a compass to distinguish between fear and love.

This awareness opens the door to creating authentic power – aligning our personality with our soul – and allows us to act consciously, even when fear is active.

The path forward is not about changing the world to end our pain; it’s about transforming our internal experience. By choosing to respond from a loving part of our personality, we create different, life-enhancing consequences for ourselves and contribute to a more compassionate world.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

(00:42) — The True Source of Emotional Pain: Why world events aren’t causing your suffering—and what is

(03:04) — Escaping the Wheel of Suffering: How fear-based reactions create a cycle of pain and how to break it

(05:59) — Old Consciousness vs. New Consciousness: Moving from external power to authentic power

(08:55) — Fear’s Painful Signature: How to recognize the physical sensations and judgmental thoughts that signal fear

(11:51) — Choosing Love Consciously: Why love can only be created through intentional choice

(15:14) — Becoming the Master of Your Life: How to move beyond the control of frightened parts of your personality

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

This week, carry a small notebook with you. Write down every time you act impulsively from a frightened part of your personality – moments when you react in anger, jealousy, resentment, or superiority. Also record the times you feel a frightened part active in you but choose instead to act from love – responding with patience, gratitude, or care while fear pushes you to react. At the end of the week, reflect on the different consequences each choice created. Which do you choose?
